blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More than 300 domestic flights to and from the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) from Nov. 13 to 19 will be rescheduled or canceled to accommodate delegates and heads of state attending the 49th Asean Summit, the Department of Transportation (DOTr) said. Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon said the flight adjustments would take effect ahead of the summit, with the first foreign delegates expected to arrive on Nov. 14.
